description: This file implements the pucch_power_controller class, which manages power control for PUCCH in a 3GPP NR (5G) context, including reconfiguration, SINR updates, and TPC command computation.

classes.name: pucch_power_controller
classes.description: Class managing PUCCH power control, including configuration, SINR updates, and TPC command calculation.

methods.name: reconfigure
methods.description: Reconfigures the power control settings based on the provided UE cell configuration.

methods.name: compute_delta_tf
methods.description: Calculates the delta transmit power factor for different PUCCH formats based on UCI bits and resource parameters.

methods.name: get_tpc
methods.description: Determines the transmit power control command based on SINR difference.

methods.name: update_pucch_sinr_f0_f1
methods.description: Updates SINR measurements for PUCCH formats 0 and 1.

methods.name: update_pucch_sinr_f2_f3_f4
methods.description: Updates SINR measurements for PUCCH formats 2, 3, and 4.

methods.name: update_pucch_pw_ctrl_state
methods.description: Stores PUCCH power control data for a specific slot, including delta TF calculation.

methods.name: compute_tpc_command
methods.description: Calculates the TPC command for a given PUCCH slot based on SINR difference and power control limits.
